test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 27 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The human brain regulates and coordinates all the voluntary and involuntary moves _____ we make.
solution:
The correct answer is **Which**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Let's see** the meaning of the words given in the options.
 
• There are two sentences, **we make** is giving extra information about **all the voluntary and involuntary moves**.
 
• We need a **relative pronoun** that will **join these two sentences**.
 
• Which
